newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler unit denies telecoms plans.
newsitem.headline: Daimler unit denies telecoms plans.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG's services unit Debis on Monday dismissed press reports that it planned to form a telecommunications alliance with media group Bertelsmann AG and retailer Metro Holding.
Debis and Metro are partners in the Debitel mobile phone group and Debis also is a partner with Bertelsmann in the Internet access company MediaWays GmbH.

The weekly magazine Focus reported that the three companies planned to merge their telecoms activities into a joint venture aimed at competing with monopoly Deutsche Telekom AG when markets are deregulated next year.

Debis spokesman Rainer Knubben said the company wanted to expand its telecoms activities and was in talks with several potential partners but added it had "no plans to form a private alliance against Telekom".
The Focus report said the three companies would announce their alliance at the CeBIT technology trade fair that begins in Hanover on Wednesday and runs until March 19.
